name: Order Confirmed
body: Hi {{firstName}}, thank you for shopping with Dare & Rise! Your order {{orderNumber}} has been confirmed. Order value: {{orderAmount}}. We’ll update you once it is shipped.

name: Address Not Clear
body: Hi {{firstName}}, thank you for your order {{orderNumber}}. The delivery address provided is incomplete or unclear. Please send your complete address with house/flat number, building/society, area, landmark, city, state and PIN code so we can process your order.

name: Order Shipped
body: Hi {{firstName}}, great news! Your Dare & Rise order {{orderNumber}} has been shipped via {{courierName}}. Tracking ID: {{trackingNumber}}. Track your order here: {{trackingUrl}}. Expected delivery: {{estimatedDeliveryDate}}.

name: COD Order Confirmation
body: Hi {{firstName}}, we received your COD order {{orderNumber}} for {{orderAmount}}. Please confirm that you would like us to process and ship this order by replying YES.

name: Customer Support Follow-up
body: Hi {{firstName}}, we’re following up regarding your query for order {{orderNumber}}. Please let us know if your issue has been resolved or if you still need assistance.

name: Review Request
body: Hi {{firstName}}, we hope you’re enjoying your Dare & Rise order {{orderNumber}}. We’d love to hear your feedback. You can share your review here: {{reviewUrl}}.

name: Abandoned Cart Reminder
body: Hi {{firstName}}, you left something behind at Dare & Rise. Your selected styles are still waiting for you. Complete your purchase here: {{cartUrl}}.
